title: Randomized Controlled Study Evaluating Genicular Artery Embolization Against Intra-Articular Corticosteroid Knee Injection for Osteoarthritic Knee Pain
official: Resorbable Embolization MicroSpheres for OsteoaRthritis Benefit
summary: Multi-center, prospective, randomized trial of GAE using Nexsphere-F against steroid injection
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient has localized knee pain
* Must be an appropriate candidate for arterial vascular access procedure

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known sensitivity or allergy to implant materials
* Unable or unwilling to comply with study requirements
